name: egui
description_en: egui: an easy-to-use immediate mode GUI in Rust that runs on both web and native
readme_excerpt: 🖌 egui: an easy-to-use GUI in pure Rust 👉 Click to run the web demo 👈 egui (pronounced "e-gooey") is a simple, fast, and highly portable immediate mode GUI library for Rust. egui runs on the web, natively, and in your favorite game engine. egui aims to be the easiest-to-use Rust GUI library, and the simplest way to make a web app in Rust. egui can be used anywhere you can draw textured triangles, which means you can easily integrate it into your game engine of choice. eframe is the official…
